description: Source code for packet line handling in Git, including functions for tracing, reading, writing, and managing packetized data streams, with support for sidebands and various packet types.

methods.name: packet_trace_identity
methods.description: Sets the trace prefix for packet tracing, duplicating the program name string.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Logs and writes a flush packet ('0000') to the given file descriptor.

methods.name: packet_delim
methods.description: Logs and writes a delimiter packet ('0001') to the given file descriptor.

methods.name: packet_response_end
methods.description: Logs and writes a response end packet ('0002') to the given file descriptor.

methods.name: packet_flush_gently
methods.description: Logs and attempts to write a flush packet, returning error code on failure.

methods.name: packet_buf_flush
methods.description: Logs and appends a flush packet to a strbuf.

methods.name: packet_buf_delim
methods.description: Logs and appends a delimiter packet to a strbuf.

methods.name: set_packet_header
methods.description: Sets the packet header with the size in hex format.

methods.name: format_packet
methods.description: Formats a packet with a prefix and payload, adding header and tracing.

methods.name: packet_write_fmt_1
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet to a file descriptor, with optional gentle error handling.

methods.name: packet_write_fmt
methods.description: Formats and writes a packet to a file descriptor.

methods.name: packet_write_fmt_gently
methods.description: Formats and writes a packet gently, returning status.

methods.name: do_packet_write
methods.description: Performs the actual write of a packet with header and data, handling errors.

methods.name: packet_write_gently
methods.description: Writes a packet to a file descriptor, with error reporting.

methods.name: packet_write
methods.description: Writes a packet to a file descriptor, aborting on error.

methods.name: packet_fwrite
methods.description: Writes a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: packet_fwrite_fmt
methods.description: Formats and writes a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: packet_fflush
methods.description: Flushes a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: packet_buf_write
methods.description: Formats and appends a packet to a strbuf.

methods.name: write_packetized_from_fd_no_flush
methods.description: Reads data from one fd and writes it in packets to another fd without flushing.

methods.name: write_packetized_from_buf_no_flush_count
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer in packets to an fd, counting packets.

methods.name: get_packet_data
methods.description: Reads packet data from fd or buffer, handling errors and EOF.

methods.name: packet_length
methods.description: Calculates packet length from hex header.

methods.name: find_packfile_uri_path
methods.description: Extracts the URI path from a packfile buffer, redacting hashes.

methods.name: packet_read_with_status
methods.description: Reads a packet with status, handling special packet types and errors.

methods.name: packet_read
methods.description: Reads a packet and returns its length.

methods.name: packet_read_line
methods.description: Reads a line from a packet stream, removing newline.

methods.name: packet_read_line_gently
methods.description: Gently reads a line from a packet stream, handling EOF.

methods.name: read_packetized_to_strbuf
methods.description: Reads packet data into a strbuf until EOF.

methods.name: recv_sideband
methods.description: Receives and demultiplexes sideband data from a stream.

methods.name: packet_reader_init
methods.description: Initializes a packet_reader struct with given parameters.

methods.name: packet_reader_read
methods.description: Reads the next packet from the stream, handling sidebands.

methods.name: packet_reader_peek
methods.description: Peeks at the next packet without consuming it.

methods.name: packet_writer_init
methods.description: Initializes a packet_writer struct.

methods.name: packet_writer_write
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet.

methods.name: packet_writer_error
methods.description: Writes an error packet.

methods.name: packet_writer_delim
methods.description: Writes a delimiter packet.

methods.name: packet_writer_flush
methods.description: Flushes the packet writer.
